name: Direct Volume Rendering with Phong Shading
aliases: 3D Direct Volume Rendering with Phong Shading
VTK Volume Rendering with Piecewise Transfer Functions
Volume Rendering with Opacity and Color TFs
definition: A direct volume rendering pipeline that maps scalar values to colors and opacities to create a volumetric, semi-transparent cloud, visualizing a 3D pressure field.
summary: Direct Volume Rendering with Phong Shading projects 3D data onto 2D using opacity functions and Phong lighting to highlight occluded regions and provide realistic depth perception.
